response: In the **Field Escalations** thread for **claim C-2026-04141**: - **Vikram Shetty** told Ravi to **cover the full amount** and said he would handle the paperwork. He added that this was the **third such issue at the site**, so it was **not the service partner’s fault**, and asked Meera to push the claim through. - **Meera Krishnan** replied that she **couldn’t authorize it based only on the Teams message**. She said **section 7.1 requires the authority to be recorded against the claim in the system**; if Vikram entered it there, she would process the claim the same day. ## Sources 1. `vikram-reply` Result from get_channel_message 2. `meera-reply` Result from get_channel_message
